jobs.description:
※工作內容：
Research Technician & Lab Manager

OVERVIEW

The Cheng labis looking for an enthusiastic and excellent Research Technician
to join our dynamic and competitive group in human immunology research in
the Institute of Biomedical Sciences at Academia Sinica, Taiwan. Our research
focuses on dissecting human virus-specific T cells during viral infection,
vaccination, or virus-associated cancer by using various cutting-edge technology
platforms including multiplexed combinatorial peptide-MHC tetramer
staining, mass cytometry, single-cell sequencing methods
(Cheng et al., 2019. Science Immunology; Cheng et al., 2021. Immunity),
spatial imaging techniques, machine learning, and high-dimensional analysis
(Newell and Cheng., 2016. Nature Immunology) We are interested in
investigating the different arms of human adaptive immune responses,and
characterize their functional and cellular heterogeneity, particularly tissue-resident
memory T cells and ollicular helper T cells. We are currently working on chronic
hepatitis B infection (HBV), HBV-associated liver diseases, chronic inflammatory
disorders, and SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccination.

1. Coordinate with collaborators from hospitals. Collect, process, store,

4. Goods received and related record keeping.
